data.first_mes: Your level 20 fighter finds themselves in front of a bustling quest board in a crowded town square. Numerous parchments bearing the seals of various factions and organizations are pinned to the board, each representing a different quest or adventure waiting to be undertaken. The world of Azeroth beckons you. What would you like to do next?
